instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and anchor one end of the band under the foot on the working side.
2. Hold the other end in your working hand at shoulder height, palm facing inward.
3. Brace your core and press the hand straight overhead until the arm is fully extended.
4. Lower the hand back to shoulder height under control.
5. Finish all reps, switch sides, and repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your wrist straight and stacked over the elbow.
2. Brace your core to resist leaning toward the working side.
3. Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower.
4. Anchor the band firmly under your foot so it cannot slip.

instructions:
1. Anchor the band at chest height and stand facing away from it.
2. Hold the handle in your working hand with the arm extended out to the side, palm forward.
3. Set feet shoulder-width apart with knees slightly bent.
4. Pull the hand in an arc across to the center of your chest.
5. Return the arm out to the side under control.
6. Finish all reps, switch sides, and repeat.
tips:
1. Keep a slight bend in the elbow throughout the movement.
2. Brace your core to stop the torso from rotating.
3. Squeeze the chest at the end of the arc.
4. Exhale as you bring the hand in, inhale as you return.

instructions:
1. Loop a band around your front leg just below the knee and anchor it in front at knee level.
2. Stand in a split stance with that leg forward and the other foot behind you.
3. Hold your hands together at your chest and keep your torso upright.
4. Bend both knees and lower straight down until the front thigh is parallel to the floor.
5. Drive through the front heel to stand back up.
6. Finish all reps, switch legs, and repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and let the band hold you back.
2. Drive through the front heel to load the quads.
3. Keep the front knee tracking over the toes.
4. Set band tension before starting so it stays taut.

instructions:
1. Anchor a band in front of you at chest height and hold a handle in each hand.
2. Step back until the band is taut and set feet shoulder-width apart.
3. Lower into a squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
4. Drive up through your heels to stand and at the same time row both handles to your ribs.
5. Extend the arms and return to the squat in one motion.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Time the row so it finishes as you reach the top of the squat.
2. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the row.
3. Keep your chest up and back flat in the squat.
4. Exhale as you stand and row, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Anchor a band overhead and hold the handle in your working hand.
2. Stand tall with your elbow tucked at your side and bent.
3. Keep the upper arm still and push the handle down until the arm is straight.
4. Bend the elbow to return the handle to the start under control.
5. Finish all reps, switch sides, and repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbow pinned to your side throughout.
2. Move only the forearm, not the shoulder.
3. Brace your core to resist twisting toward the working side.
4. Exhale as you push down, inhale as you return.
